uutiset.t: Diesel tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes capsizes near Ibiza, killing one
uutiset.s: The possible environmental damage is still being assessed by Spain's sea rescue service.

uutiset.t: Two Italians killed in strike in Kuwait, as Iran denies responsibility
uutiset.s: The pair were technicians for German company Rheinmetall, according to Italy's foreign ministry.

uutiset.t: Watch: Roofs torn off and streets under water as severe weather hits US
uutiset.s: Hundreds of thousands have been affected by storms in the country as the Thanksgiving holiday weekend begins.

uutiset.t: Nine injured, three critically, after Bangkok oil refinery explosion
uutiset.s: Black smoke could be seen across Bangkok's skyline after the blast, as officials urged residents to leave the area.

uutiset.t: New UK-EU treaty has 10-year termination clause
uutiset.s: Text of the treaties was published this afternoon, alongside legislation designed to enact the bulk of the deal.

uutiset.t: Gérard Depardieu to stand trial for alleged rape of actress in 2018, court rules
uutiset.s: A Paris appeals court rules Depardieu will go on trial for the alleged rape of Charlotte Arnould.

uutiset.t: Pregnant US inmate escapes in prison vehicle after medical appointment
uutiset.s: Rebecca Taylor had been imprisoned in New Mexico for multiple theft and burglary charges.

uutiset.t: Tributes for Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor after his death aged 65
uutiset.s: Simon Le Bon and his other bandmates say Taylor "brought an indelible fire and swagger to our music".

uutiset.t: Egyptian authorities arrest motorist over tanker crash that killed 31
uutiset.s: Officials say the man confessed to travelling at speed and clipping the fuel truck as he was overtaking traffic.

uutiset.t: Hope for millions as cheaper HIV prevention jab reaches Africa
uutiset.s: Lenacapavir, administered as an injection twice a year, is nearly 100% effective at preventing HIV infection.

uutiset.t: Myanmar refuses to comply with parts of ICJ genocide ruling
uutiset.s: A landmark ruling by the International Court of Justice (ICJ) convicted Myanmar of genocide against its Rohingya minority.

uutiset.t: Hamas political official and wife among eight Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza
uutiset.s: The killings are the latest from a series of near daily attacks by Israel against what it says are Hamas targets.

uutiset.t: Politics and peek-a-boo in Australian parliament as senator brings baby to work
uutiset.s: Senator Lidia Thorpe kept 6-month-old Aaliyah entertained, as her mum Senator Fatima Payman, participated in an online safety bill debate.

uutiset.t: Musk's plan to send a million SpaceX data satellites into space approved
uutiset.s: The Starmind constellation aims to be the most cost and energy-efficient way to meet the growing demand for AI computing power.

uutiset.t: Watch: Alaskan flying team airdrops Thanksgiving turkeys to remote communities
uutiset.s: For the last few years, the "turkey bombers" have taken to the skies for the benefit of residents in off-grid communities.
